effects.actual_behavior: Native large size2 food predicate requires Mob, nonCatfish, not CATFISH_IGNORE_EATING tag, height<=1. Smaller fish target only ItemEntity age>35. TargetFoodGoal requires water/bubble, eatCooldown<=0, notfull, nearest nonspectator accepted food within AABBinflate(8,8,8); search reset50+rand50, continuation foodalive/notfull, stop resets search5. It navigates1, computes eatDist=actorwidth*.65F+foodwidth. Within eatDist+3 and LOS add normalized mouth-to-food delta*.1F to FOOD entity; within eatDist call swallowEntity then discard original only when swallow returns true. swallowEntity(size2,Mob) sets contained flag/type and calls original Mob.addAdditionalSaveData into fresh tag, then returns true; it does not issue hurt or change target health. The source contains a Player hurt12000 branch, but native selector admits Mob or ItemEntity, Player is neither, and only canUse writes food. That branch is unreachable under pinned native selection, not an active damage candidate. No owner/team/immunity gate added to swallowing. Accepted parent hurt calls spit and returns true; rejected returnsfalse. SeaPickle hand interaction calls spit without consumption; aiStep touching seaPickle and canSpit also calls spit. dropEquipment is current inherited LivingEntity no-arg callback: drops stored items/clears, size2 spit. Spit sets clock10/eatCooldown60+rand60; largecontained resolves type/newLiving, reads only original additional data (not full Entity save), then health=max(2,maxHealth*.25), randomyaw, mouthposition. Only successful level.addFreshEntity clears contained flag/type/data; failed creation/add retains it. No native owner/source is assigned to restored actor; original add/readAdditionalSaveData can restore subclass owner data, but UUID/base entity state is not generically promised. Small/medium item spit sets zero movement/pickupdelay30 and clears slot only successful add; inventory/acquisition is otherwise excluded. CatfishSize clamps0..2/current dimensions .9x.6/1.25x.9/1.9x.9; data callback maxHP=10*size+10 and heal50, native state admission, not an offensive Stage multiplier. NBT retains contained additional data/type/flag, items and nativebucket. Bucket extra addAdditionalSaveData is detached CUSTOM_DATA copy; ItemModFishBucket restores size via actual bucket item after BUCKET_ENTITY_DATA load, reusing exact shared lifecycle.

effects.actual_behavior: isInvulnerableTo DROWN or IN_WALL orparent. hurt checks that first, then causing source.getEntity Shulker OR ShulkerBullet -> amount=(amount+1)*.33F, then parent; directentity not substituted. TicknoAI refillair; else dry/noWATER_BUCKET in mainhand decrementMoistness, <=0 and moistureAttackTime--<=0 -> command0, unsit, dryOut random1/0, reset20; otherwisewater/rain/bubble orwaterbucket restores60000. Levitation effect multiplies actorY*.5, not general motion immunity. Untamed tagged tamefood serversideusePlayerItem/fishFeedings++: only feeds>10 andrand6==0 ORfeeds>30 tame(player), nativeevents6/7; retainbinaryprobabilistic ownership, no Stageproc chosen. Parent mobInteract runs first otherwise. Tame + ItemTags.FISHES + wounded -> serverconsume/heal5, no owner-only requirement for this feeding. Ownerotherinteract can give/take one mainhanditem shift/fryable and cyclecommand0..3; command2 sets sitting,3 mining customnearesttargetrestriction,1 ownerfollow. Native owner/team are original tameable contracts. NBTsitting/command/moisture/variant plusparentowner; feedcounter/moistureAttackTime transient. Kill-score Shulker rewrite deathlootEMPTY/dropSHULKER_SHELL is acquisition, not an offensive/heal/status contribution. OwnerFollow onlycommand1/noaliveattacktarget/notsit/nonspectatorowner; nativepathrecalcevery10, distance²>=144 attempts10teleport nearowner, leash/passenger veto. Waterdestination allowed directly; landmustmoistness>=2000, nonleaves(falseconfiguration), noCollision; no extra damage/status/force toowner. Old canBreatheUnderwaterAM has no caller; actual DROWN admission already proven. Current inherited OwnableEntity.getOwner resolves only Player by stored UUID in current level; native isOwnedBy is reference equality, including null equality. Custom setOrderedToSit writes only SITTING SynchedEntityData, never parent orderedToSit. Registered vanilla SitWhenOrderedToGoal reads parent isOrderedToSit/private field, so custom command2 alone does not activate that goal. Custom isSitting still gates this actor travel, ownerfollow, cooking and nearest-tag target; it is not a universal hurt/queued-attack veto. Native parent NBT calls virtual setter and retains this distinction; no compatibility shim exists in pinned loader owner/sit patch.
